title: Ana's Small House
text:
Ana has a small house. The house has two bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room. In the living room there is a blue sofa and a big table.

The kitchen has a white fridge and a small table with four chairs. Ana's bed is in the bedroom near the window. She loves her home.

questions.text: How many bedrooms does Ana's house have?
What can we guess about Ana from the passage?
options: She does not like her home
She lives in a big castle

questions.text: Why would Ana need four chairs in the kitchen?
options: She may eat meals with friends or family there
She does not eat at home

vocabulary.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
the room where you cook food
a cold cupboard that keeps food fresh

paragraph_translations: Ana tiene una casa pequeña. La casa tiene dos dormitorios, una cocina y una sala de estar. En la sala de estar hay un sofá azul y una mesa grande.
La cocina tiene una nevera blanca y una mesa pequeña con cuatro sillas. La cama de Ana está en el dormitorio cerca de la ventana. Ella ama su hogar.
